Lemma
[Isometry group of hyperbolic space] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0195 1. ch31:31.5\group Hyperbolic isometries

$\operatorname {Isom}(\mathbb H^n)\cong \operatorname {Mob}(n-1)$, where every element is a composition of a dilation, an orthogonal map, a translation, and possibly an inversion. The orientation-preserving subgroup is characterized by the parity of the inversion and the determinant of the orthogonal map.
